name: Dokusen Saimin "Watashi o Suki ni Shite Ii kara, Ano Ko mo Mechakucha ni Shite!"
original_name: 独占催眠「私を好きにしていいから、あの娘もめちゃくちゃにして！」
source:
One day, the protagonist, Kannagi Kouya (※surname and first name can be changed), was approached by a transfer student and classmate, Fuchigami Fuyune, with a strange proposal.
“I want you to ruin Mikumo Suzuka, another classmate of ours. In exchange, you can do whatever you want with my body, even though I don’t like it.”

It was an outrageous offer, but deep down, he found it intriguing.
The protagonist had long been aware of his own twisted desire to defile women he found attractive. He’d already had his eye on both Suzuka and Fuyune.
Still, he wanted to graduate from the academy without any issues.
That was his priority.
While the offer seemed convenient, he couldn’t shake the suspicion that it might be a trap designed to set him up.
Even if it wasn’t, getting caught would almost certainly ruin his life.

‘It depends on the reason and conditions. Normally, this would be a crime, but if it somehow helps someone… Maybe I should at least hear you out…’

He was about to respond with that when—

“Alright, I’ll do it.”

The words left his mouth before he could stop himself.
Fuyune smiled at his answer, and he was certain she had somehow forced him to agree.

Not wanting to be outdone, he flashed her a smile of his own and repeated his acceptance, this time of his own volition.
For a moment, Fuyune looked surprised, but she quickly laughed, and the protagonist joined in.

He still couldn’t figure out her true intentions, but he was thoroughly intrigued.

“I’ll play along… After making her regret this thoroughly, I’ll make sure she’s happy forever.”

translation:
某天，转校生兼同班同学渊上冬音向主人公神薙皇也（※姓和名可以更改）提出了奇怪的建议。

“我想让你毁掉我们的另一个同班同学三云铃香。作为交换，你可以随意处置我的身体，哪怕我不喜欢。”

这是荒唐的提议，但他内心深处觉得很有吸引力。主人公早就知道自己有扭曲的欲望：玷污那些让自己心动的女性。他也早已盯上铃香和冬音。

不过，他想平安从学园毕业。这是他的首要目标。

这个提议看似方便，他却无法摆脱陷阱的怀疑：这也许是为了陷害他而设的圈套。即使不是，被抓住也几乎肯定会毁掉他的人生。

“要看理由和条件。通常这会构成犯罪，但如果能帮助某人……也许至少应该听你说完……”

他正准备这样回答时——

“好，我来做。”

话语不受控制地脱口而出。冬音听见回答后笑了，他确信她不知用什么方法强迫自己同意。

为了不输给她，他也露出笑容，再次表示接受，这一次是出于自己的意志。冬音短暂地露出惊讶，随即笑了起来，主人公也跟着笑了。

他仍然无法猜透她的真实意图，却彻底被勾起了兴趣。

“我会陪你玩……先让她彻底后悔，再让她永远幸福。”
